question: The in-game menu (interface/menubar.gui, window `menu`, `menu_panel` and its six buttons): what makes it, what opens it, whether the game pauses, what each button does and when it is greyed, Resign and Quit with their dialogs, Close and Escape, and what 0x66BD10 does with menu_panel.

structs.name: CQuitDialog
structs.comment: The confirmation the in-game menu's Resign and Quit buttons open: a DefaultDialog (interface/eu3dialog.gui) whose text comes from its key, "QUIT" or "RESIGN" (+0x68) - <key>_TITLE and <key>_DESC - with the player's shield on both sides, Ok (AgreeButton, ENTER) and Cancel (DeclineButton, ESCAPE). Ok (slot 5) asks the in-game screen to quit to the desktop or to end the game. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.5.
structs.evidence: Both callers (0x6728AE, 0x672A7E) allocate operator new(0x84) and pass the block to 0x6724D0, which writes the vftable 0x15CF114 at 0x67253D; RTTI gives CQuitDialog one base, CEU3Dialog at offset 0, and that table (17 slots). The Hoi3CString at +0x68 (0x1C bytes) ends exactly at 0x84. Wrong if another allocation size reaches 0x6724D0 - findRefs --callers 0x6724D0 answers exactly the two.

structs.name: CConfirmVictoryConditionResign
structs.comment: The `VCConfirm` dialog of the campaign's end (CInGameIdler::ShowVictoryConfirmDialog, constructor 0x670C20): Resign (VC_RESIGN, AgreeButton, slot 5) ends the game as the menu's Resign does; Continue (VC_CONTINUE, DeclineButton) only closes it. **Not** what the in-game menu's Resign button opens - that is a CQuitDialog. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.5.
structs.evidence: ShowVictoryConfirmDialog allocates operator new(0x6C) at 0x671A35 and calls 0x670C20, which writes the vftable 0x15CF0CC at 0x670C9E and the in-game screen (ECX) at +0x68 at 0x670CA4; RTTI gives one base, CEU3Dialog at offset 0. eu3dialog.gui's VCConfirm puts VC_RESIGN on AgreeButton and VC_CONTINUE on DeclineButton. Wrong if 0x670C20 had a second caller with another size - findRefs answers one.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::ToggleMenu
addresses.comment: **Opens the in-game menu, or closes it when it is up.** Where the menu window (+0x1CDC) is shown (+0x5B): CInGameIdler::CloseMenu(fromCustomGame) and nothing else. Otherwise: +0x1D3E = IsPaused (slot 95) - whether the game was paused already - and, **only where it was not and the game is not multiplayer (+0x68)**, TogglePause (slot 27) - so the menu pauses a single-player game and never a multiplayer one; the menu window shown (its CGuiObject's slot 13), its slot 28 (hides every subwindow: menu_panel, menu_save, menu_message_settings), then **`menu_panel` shown** (GetSubWindow, slot 27, then its CGuiObject's slot 13) - so the menu always opens on its six buttons. With fromCustomGame the window's slot 11 (not read). Then always CInGameIdler_CloseSideMenus and ClearSelection (slot 46). Without fromCustomGame also: an open country view toggled shut (AnyCountryViewOpen, then OpenCountryView on +0xCFC), +0x1D3D = 1, and bg_main_menus (+0x1914) hidden. Callers: Escape over the map with nothing selected (CInGameIdler_HandleInput, 0x653899, with 0), the top bar's `topbar_menubutton` (CTopBar::OnMenuButton, 0), the custom-game bar's `menupause` (CCgmBar::OnMenuPause, 1), CloseMenu returning from a subwindow, and three thunks of menu_save and menu_message_settings (0x66BD00, 0x66C070, 0x670240). Two `ret 4` exits, 0x66BE52 and 0x66BE6F. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Read whole off the listing 0x66BD10-0x66BE6F. The shown test is `mov eax,[esi+0x1CDC]; mov al,[eax+0x5B]; cmp al,bl; jne 0x66BE55` -> `call 0x66BE80`. The pause: `call [edx+0x17C]` (slot 95, 0x6439C0 = `mov al,[ecx+0x12D8]`), stored at +0x1D3E, called again, `jne` past and `cmp [esi+0x68],bl; jne` past `call [edx+0x6C]` (slot 27). Window slots from the CFixedWindow table 0x1601F88 (slot 27 = 0xAC2C20 GetSubWindow, slot 28 = 0xAC2DE0, which walks the +0x414 subwindow map calling each one's +0x18 slot 14). Nine direct callers by findRefs. Wrong if slot 28 were not the hide-all - its body is 0x39 bytes and calls only slot 14 on each map value.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::CloseMenu
addresses.comment: **Closes the in-game menu - or, from one of its subwindows, goes back to its six buttons.** Where `menu_save` or `menu_message_settings` (GetSubWindow on +0x1CDC) is shown, or a message-type window opened from the settings panel (+0x5F0, its window +0x10) is shown, or the in-game settings screen (+0x1D2C, a CIngameSettingsScreen) answers its slot 3 (shown): the menu window hidden (its CGuiObject's slot 14), the settings screen's slot 2 (hide), and **ToggleMenu(fromCustomGame) - the menu opened again on menu_panel**. Otherwise: **the game unpaused (TogglePause, slot 27) only where it is paused (slot 95), not multiplayer (+0x68), and +0x1D3E is clear** - paused by the menu and not before - +0x1D3E then set; the menu window hidden; the settings screen's slot 2. Because the reopen re-reads +0x1D3E while the menu's own pause holds, **a visit to Save Game, Game Options or Message Settings leaves the game paused once the menu is closed.** Callers: menu_close_button (CInGameIdler::OnMenuCloseButton), ToggleMenu on a shown menu, in-game screen slot 93 (after a country view is shut), 0x663340 (a selection-clearing path) and CInGameIdler::ShowCombatView (0x66513A) - opening a battle's window closes the menu - and the in-game settings screen's slot 5 (0x6FB952, 0x6FB965). Two `ret 4` exits, 0x66C006 and 0x66C064. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Read whole off the listing 0x66BE80-0x66C064: three `cmp byte [eax+0x5B]` tests on GetSubWindow('menu_save') and GetSubWindow('menu_message_settings') and on [[esi+0x5F0]+0x10], then `call [eax+0xC]` on [esi+0x1D2C] - CIngameSettingsScreen slot 3 is 0x6F6860 `mov al,[ecx+4]; ret`, and its slot 1 (show, 0x6FB880) is what writes +4 = 1. The sub-window arm hides (+0x18 slot 14), calls [[esi+0x1D2C]] slot 2 (+8) and `call 0x66BD10` with the argument. The other arm is the `call [edx+0x17C]`/`cmp [esi+0x68]`/`cmp [esi+0x1D3E]` diamond before `call [eax+0x6C]` and `mov byte [esi+0x1D3E],1`. Eight direct callers by findRefs. Wrong if 0x66BD10 did not re-read slot 95 on the reopen - it does at 0x66BD42, unconditionally.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::OnMenuCloseButton
addresses.comment: `menu_close_button`'s click (MENU_BAR_CLOSE "Close", shortcut ESCAPE in menubar.gui): CInGameIdler::CloseMenu(0). The constructor builds the glue at +0x1E8 with this handler (0x647601) and Enter attaches it to the button (0x65E7F7). Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.4.
addresses.evidence: The whole body is `push 0; call 0x66BE80; ret`. The constructor's `mov eax,0x66BCF0; push eax; lea eax,[ebx+0x1E8]; call 0x679650` (the glue builder takes the click handler as its first stack argument and stores it at glue +8 - the same shape that gives +0x14B0 CInGameIdler::OnLoadMultiUnit, already recorded); Enter's FindButton('menu_close_button') on GetSubWindow('menu_panel') then `[eax+0x48]` slot 1 with `lea edx,[ebx+0x1E8]`. Wrong if 0x679650 kept the handler elsewhere - the OnLoadMultiUnit record agrees with this reading.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::OnMenuOptionsButton
addresses.comment: `menu_options_button`'s click (MENU_BAR_GAME_OPTIONS "Game Options"): the in-game settings screen (+0x1D2C, a CIngameSettingsScreen on the window `menu_settings_ingame`) gets its slot 1 (show), then the menu window's slot 28 hides all its subwindows - menu_panel among them - by a tail jump. The menu window itself stays shown. Glue +0x378. What the settings screen does is the next wave's. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.4.
addresses.evidence: Whole body: `mov ecx,[esi+0x1D2C]; call [[ecx]+4]; mov ecx,[esi+0x1CDC]; mov edx,[[ecx]+0x70]; pop esi; jmp edx`. The constructor's glue at +0x378 (0x6476D3) and Enter's attach to menu_options_button (0x65EC23). +0x1D2C is written at 0x66061D with the result of 0x6FB710 on operator new(0x3E0), which writes the vftable 0x15D4BC8 - CIngameSettingsScreen by RTTI - and looks up 'menu_settings_ingame'. Wrong if slot 1 of that table were not the show: 0x6FB880 shows its window and sets +4.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::OnMenuMessageSettingsButton
addresses.comment: `menu_message_button`'s click (MENU_BAR_MESSAGE_SETTINGS "Message Settings"): the menu window shown (its CGuiObject's slot 13), its slot 28 (every subwindow hidden, menu_panel among them), then CInGameIdler_FillMessageSettings - which shows and fills `menu_message_settings` (FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md section B). Glue +0x2D8. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.4.
addresses.evidence: Whole body, 0x66F6E0-0x66F708: +0x18 slot 13, primary slot 28 (+0x70), `push esi; call 0x66F710`. The constructor's glue at +0x2D8 (0x64767F) and Enter's attach to menu_message_button (0x65EB4C). Wrong if 0x66F710 were not the recorded CInGameIdler_FillMessageSettings - project.json has it at rva 0x26F710.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::OnMenuResignButton
addresses.comment: `menu_resign_button`'s click (MENU_BAR_GAME_RESIGN "Resign"): a CQuitDialog (0x84 bytes) for the key "RESIGN" - RESIGN_TITLE "Resign Game", RESIGN_DESC "Are you sure you want to resign and return to the main menu?" - with the player (game state +0xC30) on both shields (SetDialogLeftShield, SetDialogRightShield), handed to CEU3Idler::AddDialog. **Not a CConfirmVictoryConditionResign.** The menu stays up behind it, the game still paused. Glue +0x450. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.5.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x672A10-0x672BDC: `push 0x84; call operator new`, 'RESIGN' (0x15CE85C) into a local string, `call 0x6724D0` (CQuitDialog::CQuitDialog), the lazily made g_CCurrentGameState (0x1A89790) +0xC30 into 0x63E5B0 and 0x63E610 on the dialog's window (+4), `call 0x644670`. The constructor's glue at +0x450 (0x647787) and Enter's attach to menu_resign_button (0x65E8C7). Localisation: localisation/frontend.csv. Wrong if the key string differed - the same address 0x15CE85C is what CQuitDialog::OnAgree compares against.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::OnMenuQuitButton
addresses.comment: `menu_quit_button`'s click (MENU_BAR_QUIT "Quit"): as CInGameIdler::OnMenuResignButton with the key "QUIT" - QUIT_TITLE "Quit Game", QUIT_DESC "Are you sure you want to quit and return to desktop?" - a CQuitDialog with the player on both shields, handed to CEU3Idler::AddDialog. Glue +0x4A0. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.5.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x672840-0x672A0C; byte for byte the resign handler's shape with 'QUIT' (0x15CE864, push 4) for 'RESIGN'. The constructor's glue at +0x4A0 (0x6477AF) and Enter's attach to menu_quit_button (0x65E99E). Wrong if the two handlers differed elsewhere - they differ only in the literal and its length.

addresses.name: CQuitDialog::CQuitDialog
addresses.signature: CQuitDialog* __stdcall CQuitDialog::CQuitDialog(CQuitDialog* this, CInGameIdler* idler, Hoi3CString* key)
addresses.comment: The constructor, everything on the stack, `ret 0xC`, answers this. The CEU3Dialog base on the window `DefaultDialog` (eu3dialog.gui) for the idler, the vftable 0x15CF114, the key copied to +0x68, then **the title is the localisation of key + "_TITLE" and the description that of key + "_DESC"** (GetText, CInternationalizedText::Render with the game settings' colours at +0x6C, CEU3Dialog_SetTitle, CEU3Dialog_SetDescription). Two callers, the menu's Quit ("QUIT") and Resign ("RESIGN"). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.5.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x6724D0-0x672786 (`ret 0xc`): 'DefaultDialog' (0x15CAF34) and `push ebx(this)`, ECX = [ebp+0xC] into 0x63D4B0 (CEU3Dialog's constructor, which stores ECX at +8); `mov [ebx],0x15CF114`; 0x401BD0 assigns [ebp+0x10] to +0x68; '_TITLE' (0x15CE84C) and '_DESC' (0x15CE854) appended with std::string::operatorPlus (0x65B0D0) to +0x68, GetText (0xA82490), Render (0xA82E40), 0x63E670 and 0x63E6F0. findRefs --callers: 0x6728AE and 0x672A7E. Wrong if the base took the idler other than in ECX - 0x63D4E1 is `mov [ecx+8],esi` with esi = the entry ECX.

addresses.name: CQuitDialog::OnAgree
addresses.comment: Slot 5, Ok (AgreeButton, ENTER): **where the key (+0x68) is "RESIGN", the idler's slot 74 (CInGameIdler::RequestGameOver) - the game ended into the back-end screen (CBackEndIdler); otherwise slot 73 (CInGameIdler::RequestQuit) - PostQuitMessage, to the desktop.** Neither saves. Then closed (+0x64 = 1). Cancel (DeclineButton, ESCAPE) is the base's slot 6, CEU3Dialog::Close, which only closes. Bare `ret`, two exits. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.5.
addresses.evidence: Whole body, 0x672790-0x6727EC: an inlined strcmp of +0x68 (Hoi3CString: inline under 0x10 capacity at +0x7C) with 'RESIGN' (0x15CE85C); equal -> `call [eax+0x128]` on [esi+8], else `call [eax+0x124]`; both `mov byte [esi+0x64],1`. Slot 73 = 0x64C000 and slot 74 = 0x64C010 in CInGameIdler's table 0x15CEB54, both recorded. vtable.py --holding: one table, CQuitDialog slot 5. That AgreeButton reaches slot 5: CEU3Dialog's constructor attaches the glue at +0xC (handler 0x6FB9A0 = `jmp [[ecx]+0x14]`) to AgreeButton (0x63D61E, `push edi`, edi = this+0xC) and the glue at +0x38 (0x998430 = `jmp [[ecx]+0x18]`) to DeclineButton (0x63D68E). Wrong if +8 were not the idler - see the CEU3Dialog field.

addresses.name: CQuitDialog::ScalarDeletingDestructor
addresses.comment: Slot 0: the vftable put back, the key string at +0x68 freed and emptied, the CEU3Dialog destructor (0x63D6B0), the block freed where flags bit 0 is set. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.5.
addresses.evidence: Whole body 0x6727F0-0x672837. vtable.py --holding 0x6727F0: one table, CQuitDialog slot 0 - not a fold. Wrong if the string were not at +0x68 - the constructor writes it there.

addresses.name: CConfirmVictoryConditionResign::OnAgree
addresses.comment: Slot 5, the victory dialog's Resign (VC_RESIGN): the idler (+0x68)'s slot 74, CInGameIdler::RequestGameOver - the same end as the menu's Resign - and closed (+0x64 = 1). Continue is the base's slot 6, which only closes. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.5.
addresses.evidence: Whole body: `mov ecx,[esi+0x68]; call [[ecx]+0x128]; mov byte [esi+0x64],1; ret`. vtable.py --holding 0x671320: one table, CConfirmVictoryConditionResign slot 5. Its slot 0 (0x671340) is folded across four tables and is not recorded here.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::TogglePause
addresses.comment: Slot 27: **pauses a running game or unpauses a paused one.** In multiplayer (+0x1CD0 set with its +0xF5, and +0x68) it posts a CPauseGame command (0x5C bytes, constructor 0x6D7F10) through the session's channel instead. Otherwise, where a tutorial runs (HasTutorialRunner, slot 91) and its runner's 0x8E7A60 answers false, nothing; else paused (+0x12D8) -> Unpause (slot 71), not paused -> +0x12D8 = 1. What Pause and Space call outside multiplayer (CInGameIdler_HandleInput) and what the in-game menu calls to pause and unpause. Bare `ret`, three exits. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Read off the listing 0x662FD0-0x663136. The posting arm: `cmp [edi+0x1CD0]`, `cmp byte [eax+0xF5]`, `cmp [edi+0x68]`, operator new(0x5C), 0x6D7F10 (which writes 0x15D3434, CPauseGame by RTTI), then [this slot 18]+0x38 slot 6. The local arm: `call [eax+0x16C]` (slot 91), 0x8E7A60 on +0x1D54, `cmp [edi+0x12D8],bl` -> `call [eax+0x11C]` (slot 71) or `mov byte [edi+0x12D8],1`. vtable.py --holding: one table, slot 27. The meaning of +0x1CD0/+0xF5 and of 0x8E7A60 is not read; the name rests on the local arm.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::Unpause
addresses.comment: Slot 71: outside a custom game (GetCustomGameSettings' first byte clear) +0x12D8 (paused) = 0 and +0x12D9 = 1, one word store; **in a custom game nothing**. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Whole body 0x64C480-0x64C497: `call 0x41C4E0; cmp byte [eax],0; jne; mov word [esi+0x12D8],0x100`. vtable.py --holding: one table, CInGameIdler slot 71. +0x12D9 is not identified.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::IsPaused
addresses.comment: Slot 95: `mov al,[ecx+0x12D8]; ret` - whether the game is paused. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Two instructions. vtable.py --holding 0x6439C0: one table, CInGameIdler slot 95 - not a fold. The field's reading rests on TogglePause and Unpause; ShowVictoryConfirmDialog's 'where slot 95 is clear, slot 27' fits it.

addresses.name: CTopBar::OnMenuButton
addresses.comment: **The top bar's `topbar_menubutton` (GFX_menubutton) opens the in-game menu**: CInGameIdler::ToggleMenu(0) on the top bar's idler (+0x24) - a second press closes it. The handler of the observer at +0x13C. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Whole body: `push ecx; mov ecx,[ecx+0x24]; push 0; call 0x66BD10; pop ecx; ret`. CTopBar::CTopBar writes it at +0x144 (0x6C9779) beside +0x140 = this, i.e. the glue at +0x13C, which CTopBar::Build attaches to topbar_menubutton (the record's observer_menu).

addresses.name: CCgmBar::OnMenuPause
addresses.comment: **The custom-game bar's `menupause` button** (tfh/interface/cgm.gui, M_MENU_BUTTON "Menu"): CInGameIdler::ToggleMenu(1) on the bar's idler (+0x24) - the menu opened without closing a country view or hiding bg_main_menus. Bare `ret`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: Whole body: `push ecx; mov ecx,[ecx+0x24]; push 1; call 0x66BD10; pop ecx; ret`. The bar's constructor (0x423BD0, window 'cgm_window', vftable 0x15B5F8C = CCgmBar by RTTI) writes it at +0x54 beside +0x4C = the CCgmBar glue table 0x15B6000 and +0x50 = this; 0x423EB0 keeps FindButton('menupause') at +0x34 and attaches `lea edx,[esi+0x4C]` to it (0x424226).

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::Update
addresses.comment: Per-frame update of the in game idler, virtual slot 1; calls the autosave writer (0x24FF80, `push ebx` with ebx = this, at 0x255E28). `ret 4`, but **no implementation of slot 1 reads its stack argument** - not this one, not CEU3Idler's at 0x244750, not CFrontEnd's at 0x2EDD60 (which only forwards it to the base), not CBackEndIdler's 0x208AF0 or CNudgeIdler's 0x29BE90 - so the argument is real but its meaning is not recoverable from the bodies. Frame timing is taken from the clock at +0x192C instead, into +0xA88/+0xA8C. **While the in-game menu (+0x1CDC) is shown, every frame `menu_save_button` is disabled (slot 47) in a custom game and enabled (slot 46) otherwise** (0x655D1C-0x655E19, GetCustomGameSettings' first byte) - the only one of the menu's buttons ever greyed; and closing a builder window unpauses as CInGameIdler::CloseMenu does, through the same +0x1D3E (0x656791) - see reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.4.
addresses.evidence: The added sentence only: 0x655D1C `mov eax,[ebx+0x1CDC]`, `cmp byte [eax+0x5B],0; je`; FindButton('menu_save_button') on GetSubWindow('menu_panel'); `call 0x41C4E0; cmp byte [eax],0`, then `call [edx+0xBC]` or `call [edx+0xB8]`. 0x656791 `cmp byte [ebx+0x1D3E],0`, `cmp byte [ebx+0x12D8],0`, `call [eax+0x6C]`, `mov byte [ebx+0x1D3E],1` after +0x1CE0 is freed. The rest of the comment is unchanged.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::Enter
addresses.comment: **What runs as a session comes up, for a new game and a loaded one alike.** Large; it walks every country of the game, and per country: UpdateTriggeredModifiers, RebuildStaticModifiers, RebuildRules, UpdateTotalLeadership, UpdateMaxManpower, UpdateIC, UpdateBlockadeLevel, UpdateAtWarAndEnemies and effective neutrality. **For a session not loaded from a save** it then calls SetUpCountryLawsAndTechnologyForNewGame (0x65B4E6 - the laws moved up and the technology bought to the start date, FINDINGS-starttech.md), reads the country's order of battle (CCountry::LoadOobFile, 0x65B4EC), calls SetUpCountryForNewGame and RecountUnitTotals, sets the shares of IC, counts the officers the units come with (0x65B651), and **sets up the build queue (0x65B749): for each line of +0xF40 it keeps the duration the file gave, calls slot 14, and sets progress to the new duration less the old, floored at 0** - so a file's `duration` is the days a line still has to go, and its `progress` and `cost` are thrown away. The arm beside it at 0x65B7C9 calls 0x4DCD70 and joins the same place; that it is a loaded session's is FINDINGS-unitstart.md's reading of the block and was not followed here. Then, for each of the country's units, what FINDINGS-unitstart.md section 6 has. The write that sets `in_game` is 0x4A92 bytes before the end. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-unitstart.md, section 1, and FINDINGS-buildqueue.md, section 1. **The in-game menu is made at 0x65E676-0x65EC2C**: the window `menu` (menubar.gui) through the gui's slot 11, kept at +0x1CDC and hidden, its icon `menu` given slot 33 with 1, and the six buttons of `menu_panel` attached to the glues +0x1E8 (close), +0x450 (resign), +0x4A0 (quit), +0x288 (save), +0x2D8 (message settings) and +0x378 (options), whose handlers the constructor sets (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.1).
addresses.evidence: The added sentence only: 0x65E676 'menu', `call [edx+0x2C]` on [ebx+0x60] with +0x1794, `mov [ebx+0x1CDC],eax` (0x65E6C1, the field's only writer by fieldchain --writes), +0x18 slot 14; FindIcon('menu') then slot 33 (+0x84) with 1; six FindButton-on-GetSubWindow('menu_panel') attaches with `lea edx,[ebx+N]`. The rest of the comment is unchanged.

struct_fields.name: menu_window
struct_fields.comment: The in-game menu, the window `menu` of interface/menubar.gui (the picture GFX_menu and the subwindows menu_panel, menu_save, menu_message_settings), made by CInGameIdler::Enter through the gui's slot 11 and hidden. CInGameIdler::ToggleMenu and CloseMenu show and hide it; its +0x5B is whether it is up. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.1.
struct_fields.evidence: One writer in .text (fieldchain --field 0x1CDC --writes: 0x65E6C1, after `call [edx+0x2C]` on the gui with 'menu'); 64 reads, all of the menu's names or its handlers: Enter, Update, Leave (0x662146), ToggleMenu, CloseMenu, the save, options and message handlers, FillMessageSettings, OnMessageSettingsRowClick, GetElementTooltip (message_setting_item).

struct_fields.name: menu_close_observer
struct_fields.comment: The first dword of an embedded CButtonObserverGlue<CInGameIdler> (0x50 bytes to the next, vftable 0x15CED64) whose plain click handler (glue +8) is CInGameIdler::OnMenuCloseButton; Enter attaches it to menu_panel's `menu_close_button`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.1.
